summary: W.W. Grainger filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes of unspecified size and coupon, with interest payable semi-annually and maturity left blank in the placeholder text. The notes rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt and carry a change-of-control repurchase covenant and optional redemption provisions. Joint book-running managers are J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bancorp and Wells Fargo Securities. This is a routine investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; proceeds use is undisclosed. Watch for final pricing, coupon and size, which may signal leverage or funding needs.
